description: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria Level 60 The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed. Requirements: - Demetria
name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
